name: Glorious Defender raises every Gavel's effectiveness by 25% (#2205)
contract: Glorious Defender 680634 (Spell.dbc, SpellFamilyName 33) carries SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) with EffectMiscValue SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS (8), EffectSpellClassMask word B = 32 (bit 5), EffectBasePoints 24 resolving to +25 (percent). Gavel of Light (800611), Gavel of Grace (800614) and Gavel of Wrath (800617) -- the three Gavel root spells the module's own Gavel() helper (AscensionSunCleric.cpp) recognizes -- all carry SpellFamilyFlags word B = 32, the same bit, so SpellInfo::IsAffected(33, mask) admits every one of them. Native path: Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers (Unit.cpp) calls Player::ApplySpellMod(spellId, SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS, value) for every effect of every Gavel cast, with no script required. This scenario drives that call through the harness's spell_modifier metric for all three Gavels.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Gavel of Light effect value is unmodified before the talent
Gavel of Grace effect value is unmodified before the talent
Gavel of Wrath effect value is unmodified before the talent
Glorious Defender raises Gavel of Light's effect value by 25%
Glorious Defender raises Gavel of Grace's effect value by 25%
Glorious Defender raises Gavel of Wrath's effect value by 25%
